units.name: Department of Business Administration
units.evidence: Official Business School graduate overview names the Department of Business Administration and its LSOM doctoral concentration; complete graduate curriculum explicitly expands LSOM as Logistics & Service Operations Management.

decisions.reason: Imported bare university placeholder is not a department. Actual Business Administration department is verified separately.

sources.note: Graduate Business MS/PhD overview explicitly names Department of Business Administration, academic doctoral concentrations including LSOM, and separate Service Management EIC major.

Complete eight-concentration graduate curriculum read. LSOM exact expansion Logistics & Service Operations Management; production/service processes, logistics/distribution and global SCM. Business Analytics generic decision methods not automatically classified as a separate OR doctoral route.

Exact Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Business Administration award, LSOM concentration choice, 36 credits, independent research, field/qualifying exams, dissertation defence and publication requirements.

Current Service Management EIC overview states separate part-time PhD, research dissertation and service process productivity focus; Service Operations Management in core curriculum. Exact formal operations research field and relationship to regular LSOM not established; no extra route inferred from coursework.
University official English graduate overview establishes Sogang University identity, Seoul address, graduate PhD provision and professional graduate schools including MOT.

Exact PhD in Management of Technology, cooperation course operated by Sogang Graduate School, research credits and engineering/MOT subjects. No explicit OR/Ops/IE/logistics doctoral field established from this programme page.

Complete current general graduate department inventory read in Korean: business and Service Management; mathematics/sciences; engineering electronics, chemical/biomolecular, computing, mechanical, semiconductor; interdisciplinary MOT, AI and others. Wider doctoral research fields not exhausted.

limitations: Engineering and interdisciplinary department inventory read, but full current relevant unit/programme scope remains incomplete.
LSOM is a doctoral concentration; no standalone LSOM administrative department invented. Service Management EIC and MOT provision retained as separate scope questions.
